serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Meridian Learning Management System (LMS) helps federal, state, and local government organizations and their extended network of contractors and vendors address mission-critical training issues. The Meridian LMS provides organizations with the ability to easily create, catalog, manage, track and report on all learning activities, including online, instructor-led, video-based courses as well as SCORM, AICC, and xAPI compliant e-learning. Meridian LMS includes ad-hoc reporting modules and is built to meet the needs of the public sector.
